annotation.title_clean: Cyber-physical infrastructure: an independent vision from the UK's Robotics Growth Partnership
annotation.title_en: Cyber-physical infrastructure: an independent vision from the UK's Robotics Growth Partnership
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology; Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy; Robotics Growth Partnership
annotation.summary_en: GOV.UK landing page for the Robotics Growth Partnership's independent vision report on a UK cyber-physical infrastructure (testbeds, living labs, digital twins, simulation) to speed up innovation in smart robotics across sectors. The page also links to a ministerial response. Its framing is innovation-promoting industrial policy, not regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes a connected ecosystem of virtual and physical infrastructure to make robotics innovation faster, cheaper and lower-risk
Includes testbeds, living labs, digital twins and simulation/emulation tools
Targets agriculture, manufacturing, healthcare and logistics
The Robotics Growth Partnership is an independent advisory body set up by government in 2019
Minister Freeman welcomed the report and set out next steps
